transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio — this is Aanya. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I'm Neha. We just got possession of a 3BHK in Baner and want the whole thing done — kitchen, wardrobes, living room.
Agent: Congratulations! Roughly how big is it, and when would you like to move in?
Caller: About 1,150 sq ft. We want to move in by January.
Agent: Are you the owner?
Caller: Yes, my husband and I.
Agent: Lovely. A designer will call you back within one working day to set up a free consultation.

assessment.handoff_note:
Neha Kulkarni — 3BHK, ~1,150 sq ft, Baner. New possession, full home incl. modular kitchen + wardrobes.
Move-in by January. Owner (with husband).

Agent: Good evening, Aangan Studio — this is Aanya. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, sorry for calling late. I'm Rahul — I want to redo the kitchen and living room of my 2BHK in Wakad.
Agent: No problem at all, we're here anytime. When are you hoping to get it done?

assessment.handoff_note:
Rahul Deshmukh — 2BHK, ~950 sq ft, Wakad. Kitchen + living redesign.
Flexible, before March. Owner. Called 9:40pm (after hours).

transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio — this is Aanya. How can I help?
Caller: We're opening a café in Hinjewadi, about 40 seats. Do you do restaurant interiors?
Agent: Thank you for thinking of us — Aangan focuses on homes and small offices, so a café isn't something we take on. I'd suggest a hospitality specialist.
Caller: Okay, thanks.

assessment.handoff_note: Café fit-out (40 covers), Hinjewadi — out of scope (hospitality). Closed politely.

transcript:
Agent: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio — this is Aanya. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I'm Ananya. My parents' flat in Kothrud — living, dining and their bedroom need a redesign.
Agent: Lovely. Will you be deciding on the project, or your parents?
Caller: Honestly they'll decide, I'm just finding options.
Agent: That's fine. And how much do you usually charge per square foot?
Agent: Pricing depends on the site, materials and scope — your designer will walk you through it at the consultation.
Caller: Okay. They'd want it before Diwali next year.

assessment.handoff_note:
Ananya Joshi (daughter) — parents' 3BHK, ~1,350 sq ft, Kothrud. Living, dining, master bedroom.
Before next Diwali. Parents are decision-makers — invite them to consultation. Asked about price (deflected).

transcript:
